newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police arrest Islamist demonstrators.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police arrest Islamist demonstrators.

text.p: Turkish police arrested 11 demonstrators at an illegal Islamist protest against government plans to shut down religious high schools.
Anatolian news agency said that banners in Arabic and Turkish were also seized at the demonstration after prayers on Sunday at Istanbul's Beyazit mosque, often the scene of Islamist protests.

The government of Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz has said it will expand secularist education in a bill due to be voted on in parliament in the coming weeks. The bill would effectively close Islamic schools if it were passed.
Yilmaz became prime minister last month to replace Islamist Necmettin Erbakan who quit under pressure from the powerful military.
